messages.author: d647e6438dc3aad6
messages.subject: Progress bar elements/meaning
parts:
Hi, what's the meaning of the components of the progress bar that show during runMCMC()? Like this:

running chain 1...
|-------------|-------------|-------------|-------------|
|-------------------------------------------------------|

Context: I have some jobs on a supercomputer that appear to be stuck after the first progress line (with the vertical bars). The second line (without vertical bars) has not been printed in my log, and the jobs are still running long after I expected them to finish (3x longer and counting). This is almost certainly a supercomputer issue, not a nimble/code issue, as very similar models were running just fine before and my test code runs fine on my laptop. I'm thinking something changed on the supercomputer, and identifying where the models are hanging might help identify that change/fix. I'm running only one chain per job, if that matters.

So - what's the distinction between the first line (|-------------|-------------|-------------|-------------|) and the second (|-------------------------------------------------------|) in the progress bar?

Thank you,

Emily

messages.author: 9b1f1220a2b07d1e
messages.subject: Re: Progress bar elements/meaning
parts:
Hi Emily—

The top line shows up immediately and is just used to mark the total length that the bar will become. It’s like a label line. So it sounds like your MCMC isn’t running any iterations at all! Or at least less than 1% of the total. 

Ben
